rule: best is promoted only when all tests pass AND >=1 benchmark axis improves reproducibly without correctness regression. Ties or regressions keep the prior best.

candidates.name: v0.2-baseline
candidates.note: Immutable baseline: V1 + integration phase. Reference for all future ablations.

candidates.name: v0.3
candidates.note: Fused qkv_proj + gate_up_proj (one GEMM each, mathematically identical); legacy v0.2 checkpoint migration at load time (concat + UserWarning).

evidence.fp32_prefill_dev_T256_vs_T512: candidate 2.031/3.413 ms vs baseline 2.192/3.551 ms (3 rounds)
evidence.fp32_prefill_ref50m_T512: candidate 10.50/10.99/11.17 ms vs baseline 11.79/14.78/14.23 ms (3 rounds, noisy laptop)

limitations: bf16 measurements dominated by clock-state run variance; no measurable bf16 win
checkpoint format changed (format_version=1, keys fused); v0.2 checkpoints load via transparent migration

candidates.name: v0.4
candidates.note: Opt-in static-shape CUDA-graph decode via generate(experimental_cuda_graphs=True); default eager path unchanged; batch=1, CUDA, dropout=0; window=next_pow2(prompt+max_new+1).

evidence.bitwise_equivalence: greedy ids equal eager over 16+ steps (fp32, bf16); prefill/step logits bitwise-equal
evidence.long_context_caveat: 0.94x at prompt=512 (window 1024 > eager's 544-wide attention); opt-in flagged experimental
evidence.default_path: unchanged eager; all prior tests untouched and green

limitations: opt-in only; best for short/medium prompts
window padding wasteful at long prompts (slight regression there)
capture cost amortizes over >= ~16 tokens generated

candidates.name: v0.5-candidate
candidates.note: GDN mixer opt-in (attention_type=gated_delta): memory win 32x vs GQA KV cache (128 KiB O(1) state vs 4 MiB growing at cap=2048); latency regression at every measured context (GDN ~1.0-1.1 vs dense 0.75-0.8 ms/tok; prefill ~10x slower due to missing chunked-parallel form). NOT promoted for this hardware/scale; opt-in retained for memory-constrained long-context targets. Quality unverifiable without training.

evidence.tests: 319 passed, 2 skipped (22 new GDN tests; 3 expectation fixes in fused-migration tests after model-aware migration)
evidence.correctness: cached-vs-uncached parity verified; causality verified; roundtrip bitwise
evidence.prefill_latency: T=128/512 fp32: GDN 21.1/81.9 ms vs dense 2.2/5.8 ms (sequential recurrence, no chunked form)
evidence.state_bytes: 128 KiB constant FP32 vs 4 MiB dense KV alloc (cap 2048) / 2 MiB fp32 @2048 tokens
